note: Numbered ramp steps bind no emphasis: each step is the hue itself (owner ramp rule, ADR 0018 amended).
Upsell colors mark promotions and new features: discovery intent, not accent (ADR 0018).
Emphasis words are ranked by contrast against the page; bolder reads as stronger (ADR 0018).
Accent hues are a meaning-free categorical set: usage categorical with the named hue (ADR 0017).
Numbered neutrals are ranked by contrast; no number is an intent.
Code syntax colors bind syntax roles on usage code-surface (ADR 0018).
